once_per_turn.note: not an action = [Once Per Turn] cap. Multi-fire timings (e.g. on-unsuspend) are auto-capped by the bridge via OnceFlags (cheatsheet section 7 v3) — no explicit marker needed. Otherwise gate the trigger as once.
